instruction.name: x86mftop
instruction.description: Read the x87 TOP pointer into rd.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mftop $r12; x86mftop $r13; x86mftop $r14; x86mftop $r15; x86mftop $r16; x86mftop $r17; x86mftop $r18; x86mftop $r19
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'x86mttop 0' --asm 'x86mftop $r12; x86mftop $r13; x86mftop $r14; x86mftop $r15; x86mftop $r16; x86mftop $r17; x86mftop $r18; x86mftop $r19'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.51 cycles. Measured CPI 0.3137; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 0.25. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: The TOP pointer is renamed and mftop/mttop do not form a latency chain through it: a mttop/mftop loop runs at about 1.2 cycles per pair, which is throughput, not latency. Only throughput is recorded.
